ADS NIGHTLY 8/4 — Ads Agent reported; two figures corrected by PLL Consultant oversight.

ADS AGENT SUMMARY (as received): all 5 campaigns enabled; today ContractMfg $26.31 + Samples $5.90 = $32.21, claimed "$2.21 above $30 cap"; trailing-7 $216.12 vs "$210"; one new Shopify lead (organic/direct, unattributed); no paid lead or close; no changes made; search-term mining tool-blocked.

CORRECTION 1 — NO CAP BREACH. The "$30 cap" is a remembered round number and is not the configured budget. Configured budgets read live at 21:00 ET tonight: PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 $20.33/day + PLL-Search-Samples-2026 $5.00/day = $25.33/day. Google may deliver up to 2x the daily budget on a single day and trues up to the monthly average, so a single day above budget is normal pacing, not a breach. Trailing 16-day average $25.99/day = 86.6% of the $30/day approved nominal. NOT A BREACH.

CORRECTION 2 — TRAILING-7 SPEND. Verified from live source data for Jul 29 - Aug 4: $209.93 (579 impressions, 79 clicks, 13.64% CTR, $2.66 avg CPC). Prior 7 days Jul 22-28: $142.09 (438 impressions, 76 clicks, 17.35% CTR, $1.87 avg CPC). Ads Agent's $216.12 does not reconcile and appears to blend legacy campaigns.

SCOPE WARNING — "all 5 campaigns ENABLED" is out of scope. New-ads figures cover only PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 (24049588003) and PLL-Search-Samples-2026 (24040031889). Legacy Initial, New-Sales-Ad, and Sales Campaign PLL must never be blended. CAMPAIGN-SCOPE - EXACT SEVEN-AD ROSTER UNVERIFIED.

OPEN ITEM FOR SAM — the Samples daily budget dropped from $10.33 (verified 8/3) to $5.00 (verified 8/4). Unexplained account-side change. Confirm who made it.

LEADS / ATTRIBUTION — current 7 days: 10 qualified inquiries, 2 verified ContractMfg-attributed, 7 UNATTRIBUTED, 1 legacy out-of-scope. Prior 7 days: 14 inquiries, 1 unique verified Samples lead. Booked calls 7 current / 4 prior, 0 verified Ads-attributed. Cost per booked call NOT YET MEASURABLE.

CACHE — this callback carried no structured ads_intelligence object, so no cache refresh was taken from it. brief.json was independently refreshed at 21:00 ET tonight from live source data and verified live (commit 7585cbc).

RECOMMENDATION (read-only, pending Sam's yes/no) — switch ContractMfg from Maximize Conversions to Manual CPC. CPC is up 62% week over week with no working conversion signal for smart bidding to optimize toward. Manual CPC caps the premium until attribution is fixed. No change made.
spoken_text: Sam, here's the bottom line. Ads Agent reported tonight, but it called a cap breach that is not real, so I corrected it. Over the last seven days the new ads spent about two hundred ten dollars, with click-through down to about fourteen percent and cost per click up to two dollars sixty-six. Compared with the prior seven days, we paid more and got roughly the same number of clicks, so efficiency slipped. We logged ten qualified inquiries and seven booked calls, but only two inquiries are provably from ads and none of the booked calls are, so cost per booked call still isn't measurable. One thing needs your answer: the White Label Samples daily budget dropped from ten dollars to five, and nobody told me why. My read is that smart bidding is paying a premium with no conversion signal to learn from. I recommend switching Contract Manufacturing to manual cost per click until attribution is fixed.
